source: https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Zulrah "Damage at Zulrah is capped at 50, with any hits greater than this amount dealing 45-50 damage instead."

https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1375037874559721474 "ignoring whatever damage you rolled, and simply picking a number 22-24" — a replacement, so a hitsplat at or below 24 is untouched. https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Maximum_damage_cap words it the same way: "Any hitsplats done to the boss above 24 damage will be re-rolled to 22-24 damage".

https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Maximum_damage_cap "Any hitsplats done to the boss with melee above 10 damage will be re-rolled to 0-10 damage" (Mod Ash, 7 Sep 2018) — only an over-cap hitsplat rerolls, so a sub-cap one is untouched. https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Verzik_Vitur "melee is capped at 10 damage per hitsplat"; the Dawnbringer is exempt.

The Ranged and Magic half of the row above, same articles and same exemption: "Any hitsplats done to the boss with ranged or magic above 3 damage (excluding Dawnbringer) will be re-rolled to 0-3 damage".

https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Corporeal_Beast "The damage cap of 50 for halberds and spears has been increased to 100." https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Maximum_damage_cap scopes it: "Applies to Corpbane weapons set to Stab; ranged and non-Corpbane melee weapons have their damage reduced by 50%" — the halved path is CorporealBeastReduction, and no source says it keeps the legacy 50, so it is left uncapped.
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Leviathan "Damage against it is capped at 10 when stunned" — anywhere but the backside wound, which is its own situation.
